_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: Model upgrade banner offers once to repeat the switch on other chats. The server offers an upgrade from the predictable model to a newer "Predictable Next" (ID predictable-next); there is another conversation still on the predictable model; switching a conversation's model lands (the settings POST is faked to succeed); and repeating the switch on the other chats (POST /api/model-upgrade/apply-all) is faked to answer that 2 chats were switched and 1 skipped. Call "apply all" returns the JSON body of the first apply-all request, or "none". "The offer" is the element with data-testid "model-upgrade-all-banner". Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. 2. The element with data-testid "model-upgrade-banner" should be visible (the page has loaded the upgrade). 3. There must be exactly 0 offers. 4. Click the element with data-testid "model-upgrade-action". 5. The offer's text should contain "Switch your other". 6. The offer's text should contain "Predictable Next". 7. Call "apply all": it must return exactly "none". 8. Click the element with data-testid "model-upgrade-all-action". 9. The exact switch just made travels with the request: call "apply all" until it returns exactly {"from":"predictable","to":"predictable-next"}. 10. There must then be exactly 0 offers. 11. The count is said, not left to guesswork: the text of the element with data-testid "model-upgrade-all-result-banner" should contain "Switched 2 chats from". 12. Its text should contain "Skipped 1 chat still running".
